canonical_definition:
What it is. The available description treats ToolACE as a dataset with 11,300 rows, used as a supplementary evaluation set in function-calling safety tasks. The same usage also describes it as a complementary part of MCIP-Bench, used to further validate generalization capability.

What it is claimed to measure. The available paper reports ToolACE as being used to further validate generalization capability in function-calling safety tasks. Papers do not explicitly link it to any construct or behavioral indicator.

Space of uses. The observed usage positions ToolACE alongside MCIP-Bench as a supplementary or complementary evaluation resource rather than as a standalone benchmark. In that role, papers use its 11,300 rows to provide an additional generalization check.
papers: Improving Large Language Models Function Calling and Interpretability via Guided-Structured Templates
MCIP: Protecting MCP Safety via Model Contextual Integrity Protocol
iTool: Reinforced Fine-Tuning with Dynamic Deficiency Calibration for Advanced Tool Use
